name: SoccerNet Tracking
qualification: Source and setup are inspectable. Current public-alpha managed inference and training are not qualified; historical provider evidence is not current compatibility evidence.

environment.python: CPython 3.12 on Linux x86-64; a compatible CUDA environment is required for real MOTR execution
environment.accelerator: Compatible CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU for real inference or training
dependencies: PyTorch and torchvision compatible with the host CUDA runtime
SoccerNet client 0.1.62 where official acquisition requires it
environment.installation: Create an isolated environment, then follow the pinned MOTR and SoccerNet instructions. Dependency installation is manual because the upstream ML/CUDA matrix is not qualified by this alpha.

acquisitions.name: MOTR source
acquisitions.access: Public source checkout; network access is required only for an explicit fetch.
acquisitions.instructions: Fetch the pinned detached checkout or bind an existing clean checkout at the exact commit.

acquisitions.name: SoccerNet Tracking data
acquisitions.access: Official registration, terms, and any requested NDA credential apply. ModelForge does not accept terms, collect credentials, or fetch match data.
acquisitions.instructions: Use SoccerNet's official acquisition process and bind the resulting absolute local root with --use soccernet-data=PATH.

acquisitions.name: User-selected MOTR checkpoint
acquisitions.revision: user-selected checkpoint compatible with pinned MOTR source
acquisitions.access: Checkpoint provenance and redistribution terms must be reviewed independently; no public-alpha checkpoint identity is qualified.
acquisitions.instructions: Acquire or produce a compatible checkpoint, record its digest and provenance, and bind it as an external path. Setup alone does not qualify inference.

actions.qualification: The source adapter is inspectable; current public-alpha managed execution has not passed.
Training remains outside the public alpha and the reserved-test/self-promotion prerequisite remains open.
